current_suggestion.pitch: Wait — Israetel also posts solo under his own channel distinct from the RP brand, where he goes deeper on the philosophy of science in nutrition and training, steelmanning low-carb and carnivore critiques with actual mechanistic rigor rather than dismissing them. He covers the epistemology of how we know what we know in health science — a gap between your data-heavy channels like Attia and the more advocacy-oriented carnivore voices. Format is primarily solo essays and debates, often 20–60 minutes, at a level of scientific literacy that rewards close attention.
